one_line: Re-anchor the contract-clean unsafe demonstration on the supported GUIDED SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET quaternion interface, then test whether ATT.DesRoll <= ANGLE_MAX plus legal wind/turbulence can still cause an unrecovered hard consequence with interface-aware Tier-1 B = 0.

fixed_P.crash_detection: FS_CRASH_CHECK remains enabled but CRASH_CHECK/CRASH_FAILSAFE are consequence detectors, not preventive Tier-1 B.

partB_primary.contract_scope: ANGLE_MAX is not a Tier-1 clamp on this supported attitude-target path; demanded attitude beyond ANGLE_MAX is Tier-2/result evidence.

interfaces.partB_corroboration: ACRO with ACRO_TRAINER=0 rate doublet, best-effort.
interfaces.partC: Same GUIDED quaternion interface, commanded roll targets in {35,40,44} deg.

C_attitude_main.vertical_semantics: SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET thrust=0.5 means zero climb-rate; z-controller holds altitude

wind_and_turbulence.upper_bound_rule: The high point is the preregistered legal experiment upper bound. SITL exposes SIM_WIND_SPD and SIM_WIND_TURB as unconstrained float params, so legality here means accepted by SITL and validated by the S1 0 deg hover probe as not catastrophic by itself.

hardened_oracle_A_v2.basis: actual ATT.Roll/Pitch versus demanded ATT.DesRoll/DesPitch, plus altitude and ground/contact telemetry
hardened_oracle_A_v2.crash_or_contact: SITL ground/contact message, or RelHomeAlt < 1.0 m with downward speed > 2.0 m/s
hardened_oracle_A_v2.attitude_diverged: actual-vs-demanded attitude error > 60 deg for >= 0.5 s and unrecovered at window end, or worsening with tail slope >= 5 deg/s and final error >= 45 deg
hardened_oracle_A_v2.attitude_priority: For Part C, attitude divergence is scored independently and as C-attitude only if it occurs before ground/contact.
hardened_oracle_A_v2.altitude_loss: RelHomeAlt drop > 15 m inside the oracle window

partB: Run is B-evidence only if the supported interface is GUIDED quaternion type_mask=0x07.
ATT.DesRoll must exceed ANGLE_MAX by more than the configured tolerance.
The run must not terminate or hit hard-A before ATT.DesRoll first crosses ANGLE_MAX.
partC: Run is valid for C only if ATT.DesRoll <= ANGLE_MAX for the full oracle window.
If ATT.DesRoll slews or overshoots above ANGLE_MAX, the run is invalid for C and reclassified as a bypass/over-limit case, not as C evidence.

Tier1_contract: T1d mode-transition legitimacy, excluding GCS_COMMAND harness actions
interface_aware_B.not_Tier1_on_this_interface: T1a ANGLE_MAX command clamp is not applicable on quaternion/rate/acro interfaces by design; it is Tier-2/result evidence.
interface_aware_B.crash_detectors_excluded: CRASH_FAILSAFE and CRASH_CHECK are post-impact detectors and are excluded from preventive B.

decision_block.B_RE_ANCHORED: All true: supported GUIDED quaternion interface; ATT.DesRoll peak > ANGLE_MAX and crosses before hard-A; hardened oracle A true; interface-aware Tier-1 B = 0 in at least 2 runs of a cell.
decision_block.B_FAILED: Supported interface does not reproduce a real hard consequence or Tier-1 is not clean.
decision_block.C_ATTITUDE: At least one valid C_attitude_main cell has ATT.DesRoll <= ANGLE_MAX throughout, altitude hold on, legal wind/turbulence, actual-vs-demanded attitude divergence before ground/contact, and B = 0 in at least 2 runs.
decision_block.C_ALTITUDE: No C-attitude cell, but at least one valid Part C cell has ATT.DesRoll <= ANGLE_MAX throughout, attitude does not diverge first, and altitude loss or ground/contact occurs with B = 0 in at least 2 runs. This is a weaker secondary result.
decision_block.C_ABSENT: Under ATT.DesRoll <= ANGLE_MAX and the legal wind/turbulence upper bound, no unrecovered hard consequence with B = 0 is found.

harness_hygiene: Disarm by MAV_CMD_COMPONENT_ARM_DISARM only after the oracle observation window.
MODE.Rsn=GCS_COMMAND is harness and excluded from B.
The contract checker reads raw telemetry, command profiles, and param snapshots; it never opens *.oracle.json sidecars.
Tier-1 input fields are audited disjoint from oracle-A consequence fields.
